selected_evidence.requirement: /tmp and /dev/shm mounted noexec, nosuid, nodev before reboot
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed /tmp not separately mounted and /dev/shm lacking noexec; added fstab entries and remounted live to apply noexec,nosuid,nodev to both.

selected_evidence.requirement: Functional proof that exec, setuid, and device nodes are ignored on /tmp and /dev/shm
selected_evidence.summary: Script execution denied on both /tmp and /dev/shm (noexec); mknod device node created but read access denied (nodev); setuid-copied binary in /tmp failed to execute (nosuid/noexec).

selected_evidence.requirement: Settings persist in fstab / survive reboot config check
selected_evidence.summary: /etc/fstab contains tmpfs entries for /tmp and /dev/shm with defaults,nosuid,nodev,noexec; findmnt --verify reported no errors for these entries.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node-restart evidence protocol for node1: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, post-restart recovery
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id (28ae5f98...) and healthy mount state; issued deferred reboot with returned acknowledgement; node became unreachable then reconnected with new boot_id (deae565f...), proving a real restart; post-restart findmnt and exec tests confirm /tmp and /dev/shm retained noexec,nosuid,nodev and actively block script execution.
